column6: Negative or potentially reputationally damaging coverage involving Sedifly, Joash, a current strategist, active partner, or active/recent event.
column7: Allegation, complaint, criticism, misleading framing, controversy, legal/regulatory concern, or rapidly spreading negative post.
column8: Archive + log immediately; mark priority Critical; send alert with source, summary, confidence, sentiment, reach signal if available, and recommended next action.
column9: Ben reviews immediately and decides whether to respond, escalate, correct, or monitor.
column10: As soon as detected; target <30 min from system detection.
column11: Do not wait for full metadata enrichment before alerting. False-positive risk is preferable to delayed escalation for reputational issues.

column6: Material factual error or misrepresentation about Sedifly, Joash, products/services, partnerships, events, traction, or strategist credentials.
column7: Wrong title, false partnership claim, incorrect event detail, inaccurate company facts, or misleading quote attribution.
column8: Archive + log; mark Critical; highlight the exact disputed claim and source evidence.
column9: Ben verifies and coordinates correction/escalation if needed.
column11: Only alert where the error is material enough to affect reputation, conversion, partner relations, or public understanding.

column6: Major/high-reach publication or high-profile account directly features Sedifly or Joash, or a time-sensitive feature creates a clear same-day amplification opportunity.
column7: National/business media feature, prominent founder profile, major partner announcement, significant speaker/event coverage.
column8: Archive + log; mark High; generate suggested organic-content angle and amplification options; send alert.
column9: Ben decides whether to repost/respond/brief content.
column10: Same day; target <1 hour from system detection.
column11: High reach alone is not enough if Sedifly/Joash relevance is incidental.

column6: Active partner or event coverage where value decays quickly and a same-day response/repost would materially improve reach or relationship value.
column7: Live event post, partner announcement, speaker-tagged post during/just after event, organiser recap released while event is still fresh.
column8: Archive + log; mark High; suggest repost/respond angle and channel.
column9: Ben reviews; Clarissa/Mandy only act if assigned.
column11: Use event/partner status and review dates in Monitored Entities to avoid alerting on stale back-catalogue posts.

column6: High-impact item with low classification confidence that could reasonably belong in any instant-alert class.
column7: Ambiguous post from a major outlet, uncertain negative sentiment, unclear identity match involving Joash/strategist.
column8: Create exception; archive if possible; send alert marked Needs verification.
column9: Ben or named backup verifies classification.
column11: Do not silently downgrade a potentially important item because the model is uncertain.

column6: Normal positive/neutral direct mention of Sedifly or Joash that is meaningful but not time-sensitive.
column7: Routine article mention, standard partner recap, normal social mention, non-urgent profile reference.
column8: Archive + log; classify; set Organic content opportunity? Yes/No with suggested angle; include in next digest.
column9: Mandy/QA verifies exceptions; Ben reviews only Yes opportunities.
column10: Daily digest during pilot; cadence can move to 2–3x weekly after handover if volume is low.
column11: Direct Sedifly/Joash coverage should never be archive-only unless duplicate/syndicated or historical.

column6: Meaningful current-strategist coverage that is relevant under the Strategist category but does not require same-day action.
column7: Interview, quote, expert commentary, university/profile feature, award, or thought-leadership mention.
column8: Archive + log; classify Strategist; flag content opportunity where useful; include in digest.
column9: Ben reviews only flagged Yes items.
column11: Strategist coverage is in scope even if Sedifly is not mentioned, per the existing guide.

column6: Routine active-partner/event coverage that should be retained but has no immediate response need.
column7: Post-event photo dump, routine partner recap, secondary event listing, non-urgent repost.
column8: Archive + log; classify Event; include in digest; suggest content angle only if differentiated from existing coverage.
column11: Avoid repeatedly surfacing near-duplicate partner/event posts.

column6: New non-media listing or relevant General-category item with clear Sedifly/strategist/market relevance.
column7: Company directory listing, relevant education/EdTech/AI article authored by a Sedifly team member, useful market-intelligence item.
column8: Log; archive where useful; include only if materially relevant.
column11: General-category monitoring must use a relevance threshold; do not surface generic education/AI news.

column6: Duplicate/repost of an item already logged with no new audience, context, claim, or amplification value.
column7: Same LinkedIn post forwarded by three people; exact duplicate URL; repost with no additional commentary.
column8: Deduplicate; attach source/forward count if useful; do not create a second active item.
column11: If a repost adds meaningful new commentary or comes from a materially different/high-value account, treat as a new item.

column6: Syndicated copy where a stronger/original source is already logged and there is no unique value.
column7: Wire copy republished across many low-value outlets.
column8: Log source URLs if useful for completeness; archive only representative/top outlets; suppress alerts.
column11: Preserve the original/highest-value source as the canonical record.

column6: Low-value directory/non-media listing with no material reputation, SEO, or conversion significance.
column8: Log if required by taxonomy; no alert; archive only if the guide/process requires preservation.
column11: Escalate to Digest if the listing contains inaccurate or harmful information.

column6: Historical/back-catalogue item discovered after its timely amplification window has passed.
column7: Old founder profile or event recap found weeks/months later.
column8: Archive + log with historical/back-catalogue note; no active alert.
column9: None unless Organic content opportunity is unusually strong.
column11: A historically important feature may still be flagged Yes for content, but it should not trigger an instant alert.

column6: Low-relevance General-category material that technically matches broad Education/EdTech/AI terms but does not materially involve Sedifly, a monitored strategist, partner/event, or a defined market-intelligence question.
column7: Generic AI-in-education news with no Sedifly/team connection.
column8: Suppress from active queue; optionally retain in low-priority market-intelligence archive if configured.
